selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent config file created and applied
selected_evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf and applied with sysctl --system, showing new values loaded
Detected eth0 accept_redirects still 1 after all/default set to 0, applied and persisted eth0-specific override, verified all interfaces at 0

selected_evidence.requirement: Boot identity baseline and first restart proof
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 15443601..., issued reboot (ack returned), node briefly unreachable, reconnected with new boot_id 08f9094d... and new uptime -s, proving restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart settings check surfaced lo regression, fixed and persisted
selected_evidence.summary: lo.accept_redirects reverted to 1 after reboot; added lo entry to sysctl.d file and reapplied, confirmed 0

selected_evidence.requirement: Second restart proof and final persistence verification
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 08f9094d... pre-reboot, issued second reboot, node unreachable then reconnected with changed boot_id 4b9f3de9..., and all/default/eth0/lo accept_redirects and accept_source_route confirmed 0 across the board, with config file contents verified

commands.command:
cat > /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf <<'EOF'
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
EOF
cat /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf

net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0

net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0

commands.command:
for f in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects; do echo "$f: $(cat $f)"; done
echo ---
for f in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_source_route; do echo "$f: $(cat $f)"; done

sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.eth0.accept_redirects=0 net.ipv4.conf.eth0.secure_redirects=0
for f in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects; do echo "$f: $(cat $f)"; done

sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.lo.accept_redirects=0
cat >> /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf <<'EOF'
net.ipv4.conf.eth0.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.eth0.secure_redirects = 0
EOF
cat /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf

net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects = 0

net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.eth0.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.eth0.secure_redirects = 0

commands.command: for f in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_source_route; do echo "$f: $(cat $f)"; done
